materials.cover_letter:
I build AI workflows that solve real operational problems, and I know they work because I measure them. Your AI Solutions Architect role is exactly that: consulting with teams, configuring tools, and building bespoke agents and internal tools that get adopted and used. I have been doing this work for years, and I would welcome the conversation.

At Redwood, I built FlareGuard, an AI content validation workflow with automated quality checks and regression detection. Escalations dropped 70-80%. I also redesigned a 200-article help portal with role-aware navigation, automated the documentation pipeline with screenshots and PDF generation, and fixed a customer complaint that had persisted for years. I did this by sitting with Support and Engineering, mapping their workflows, and shipping solutions they actually wanted to use.

That is the job: assess, build, train, support, repeat. I have done it across teams and systems, from Zendesk migrations to custom AI validation suites. If you need someone who can deliver white-glove AI enablement and own the whole cycle, that is me. I would welcome the chance to talk.

short_answers.Why this company?: MRO's focus on delivering white-glove AI enablement and bespoke workflow solutions aligns perfectly with my experience building custom AI tools like FlareGuard and automating documentation pipelines. I'm drawn to the opportunity to consult across business units, assess workflows, and deploy tailored AI solutions that drive measurable outcomes—exactly what I've done at Redwood and Attentive.
short_answers.Tell us about yourself: I'm Kara Novotny, an AI Workflow Engineer with a background in technical writing and content strategy. Over the past few years, I've specialized in integrating AI into documentation workflows—building validation tools, automating pipelines, and training teams on prompt engineering. At Redwood, I designed FlareGuard, which cut escalations by 70-80%, and I've consistently partnered with cross-functional teams to identify AI opportunities and deliver scalable solutions. I'm excited about MRO's mission to provide consultative AI enablement and would love to bring my hands-on experience with tool setup, training, and workflow configuration to your team.
